messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Use the reference image to define the target environment. Keep the same person, hairstyle, hair color, outfit, expression, and action. Maintain the existing camera framing and movement, and light the person naturally within the new scene.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands on a concrete ledge, raises both hands to adjust her hair, then turns to face away from the camera while posing with one hand on her hip.","camera":"A static, full-body, eye-level shot from a side-rear angle.","clothing":"She wears a pink-and-white gingham bodice with white off-the-shoulder puff sleeves, a white wrap skirt with a black leather panel, and light-blue slip-on sneakers with white soles.","hair_color":"Blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair pulled back into a low bun with a light-colored scrunchie.","identity":"A slim young woman with fair skin, shown mostly in profile and from behind.","scene":"An outdoor concrete platform or rooftop overlooking a calm sea under a clear, pale blue sky in bright daylight."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background changed from a cobblestone city street with storefronts to a concrete platform overlooking a calm sea under a clear sky. The woman remains in the same full-body side-rear framing and performs the same hair-adjusting and turning motion, with her outfit and hairstyle largely preserved.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the original street scene with the concrete seaside platform shown in the reference, while preserving the same person, hairstyle, outfit, action, camera framing, and natural lighting.
uncertain: Exact match of the new environment to the reference image cannot be fully verified from the provided frames, though the sea, sky, and concrete platform are consistent.
unexpected_changes: The ground changed from cobblestones to cracked concrete, as required by the new scene, but the person's contact shadow and foot placement appear less consistently grounded in some frames.
